title: I think you need more developers!
prompt: I think you need more developers!

messages.text: I think you need more developers!

I have checked the backlog and found we have more than 8 cards pending, including bugs and features. I have asked the co-founder whether to create new feature cards this cycle or focus on improving and closing existing ones. I also asked if they want me to propose hiring more developers to accelerate progress.

Meanwhile, I will monitor the co-founder's response and continue managing current priorities.
